messages:
elaine: Heads-up — my PR with the migration guide for the new embeddings config failed docs-ci preflight. linkcheck + remark-lint both complained. I'm going to paste the failing bits.

ci-bot: docs-preview job failed on 2141590000
ci-bot: Errors: linkcheck (2), remark-lint (MD013, MD033), spellcheck (3), vale (prose/consistency)

mike: can you paste the specific linkcheck output? I can triage the dead link quickly.

elaine: linkcheck output: `ERROR: Dead link https://old.examples/redwood-embed -> 404` and `ERROR: Anchor not found #usage-examples in migration.md`

sophie: for the anchor one — I moved the heading in a refactor. Easiest is to add the explicit anchor `<!-- #usage-examples -->` next to the heading or update the link target. Which file is that in?

elaine: it's in docs/migrations/migration-embeddings.md. I think I renamed the section to "Client usage examples" and forgot to update an internal link. I'll update the link to the exact heading slug.

jon: on MD013 (line length), we should avoid hard-wrapping long code blocks. Try running `npm run docs:format` locally — it runs prettier + remark. Command I run locally:
```
# from repo root
npm ci
npm run docs:format && npm run docs:lint
```

mike: vale flagged a consistency issue: it suggests replacing "embedder" with "embedding model" across the guide. We should follow the style guide. Quick grep:

```
grep -n "embedder" -R docs/ | sed -n '1,5p'
```

elaine: I'll update wording. My question: do we want to fix all occurrences in this PR or only the ones in migration-embeddings.md? I'm leaning to fix only this doc and open a separate sweep PR.

sophie: fix only this file in this PR — smaller change, easier to review. Add a follow-up ticket for a repo-wide terminology sweep.

elaine: sg. I'll push fixes: update the anchor, replace the dead external link with the new examples URL (https://examples.redwood.ai/embeddings), and run the formatter.

(20 min later)

elaine: pushed changes. CI kicked off.

ci-bot: docs-preview job started for PR #4723
ci-bot: linkcheck: passed
ci-bot: remark-lint: passed (MD013 warnings resolved)
ci-bot: spellcheck: still 1 warning (typo: "paramters")

mike: lol classic — I'll grab that one. Is it in the code snippet or prose?

elaine: prose, under "API params" section.

mike: fixed and pushed. Also added a note in PR description about not doing a global terminology sweep here.

ci-bot: docs-preview job started for PR #4723 (rerun)
ci-bot: All checks passed ✅

sophie: awesome. who should merge? any blockers?

jon: I'll do the merge after a quick skim for broken examples. Plan to merge in the quiet window at 16:30 PT to avoid the release gate.

elaine: thanks all! filing the follow-up ticket now: DOCS-532 (terms sweep: "embedder" -> "embedding model").

mike: nice. also added a small test in the docs CI to catch the specific anchor-case that slipped through — it treats internal link targets as case-insensitive now.

elaine: great, that should help. :thumbsup:

sophie: noted for the release notes: add a short entry about embeddings migration doc updates.

jon: merged at 2141590120 — thanks team.
